```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Health Savings Accounts allow people to own and control their health care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Health Savings Accounts are an important step toward creating a consumer-driven health care system that puts patients and doctors at the center of decision-making, not government bureaucrats.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When consumers make decisions about health care, individuals control their health care dollars and health care decisions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Health Savings Accounts allow people to save, earn interest, and spend tax free on their health care needs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Health Savings Accounts are combined with a low-premium, high-deductible health insurance plan to offer flexible, affordable insurance options for small businesses and individuals.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Health Savings Accounts are now available to all Americans thanks to the efforts of President Bush and the Republican Congress.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Party endorses extending tax deductibility to the insurance premiums associated with Health Savings Accounts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for efforts to expand the use of Health Savings Accounts to help control health care costs and give individuals more power in making important medical decisions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
